plan: Built off the five rooms' crack lines together: Fighting, Ground and Water pressure, spread damage to beat Metal Burst and Illusion, Protect for the Head Smash turn, a Dark lead that ignores Prankster, and Good as Gold against Corrosion Toxic and Thunder Wave. Surging Strikes always crits through Coil and Iron Defense and its three hits break Sturdy and Focus Sash. Mega Swampert's Earthquake is the spread move; Landorus is immune to it. Incineroar Fake Out beats Salandit's and Shiftry's Fake Out on speed only when faster, so it is used as the Knock Off and Intimidate piece instead.
